reading: GRÜN · §102 — the halo's chroma share, and §94's requirement corrected from a lower bound to a figure
whatWasOwed: §94 used each pixel's TOTAL chroma as the c in c >= 2q/(p*relSwing). The breath modulates only the HALO's contribution, so the requirement is larger by 1/share and §94's 75.1 / 214.6 were a LOWER BOUND.
whyTakeItAnyway: GELB ruled it can only move the unselected limb toward decided, never away. A figure that can only help the conclusion is exactly the figure A-G140 forbids leaving unmeasured.
shareIsADifferential: C* is not additive over layers, so (C_all - C_without)/C_all is NOT an algebraic share. It is the chroma the halo CONTRIBUTES at that pixel, measured as A-F19 requires — an excess against a render without it, never a raw window. A ratio of two measured quantities invites being read as a partition; this one is not one.

spreadDomain.everySpreadHere: WITHIN ONE RUN — repeat-to-repeat across suppression cycles in a single browser launch, after a discarded warm-up.
spreadDomain.excluded: browser launch and page load. §99 measured those two domains differing by roughly a factor of two on a comparable quantity.
spreadDomain.twoMediansAndWhyTheyDiffer: the per-cycle median above is taken over ALL hue-glow pixels INCLUDING those whose differential contribution is <= 0; the haloChromaShare block below is over the EVALUATED (positive-contribution) subset only. Both are medians of a 'share' and they are 0.475 and 0.728 respectively. Named because two differently-filtered medians under one word is the A-G417 shape — a property of a sub-population read as a property of the whole — and a reader comparing them would conclude the instrument was inconsistent.

population.whyTheyWereDropped: at these pixels the halo's DIFFERENTIAL chroma contribution is <= 0 — hiding the halo did not reduce C*, and at some pixels it raised it. That is not an error: compositing is not additive, and a cyan layer at low alpha over a dark near-neutral ground can leave the ground's own chroma MORE dominant when removed, which is §79's finding reaching a share figure. A share is undefined where the contribution is not positive, so those pixels carry no corrected requirement.
population.andTheyTravelWithEveryFigureBelow: GELB §91: a share without its denominator cannot be audited. Every figure in this reading is over the EVALUATED population and says so.

theCeilingAfterCorrection.note: §94's uncorrected figures were 75.1 unselected and 214.6 selected against a best pixel of 73.20.

finding:
THE HALO'S CHROMA SHARE, over the EVALUATED population of 30130 of 47073 hue-glow pixels (36.0 % DROPPED, because hiding the halo there did not reduce C* — compositing is not additive and removing a cyan layer over a dark ground can leave the ground's chroma more dominant, which is §79 reaching a share figure): median 0.72802, p10 0.27841, p90 0.8715, max 1. So at the median pixel the halo contributes 72.8 % of the chroma, and the breath can only modulate THAT part.
§94's REQUIREMENT WAS A LOWER BOUND AND IS NOW A FIGURE: corrected for share, 10 % precision on the UNSELECTED amplitude needs c/q >= 103.16552 at the median pixel (§94 said 75.1 for every pixel), and 0 of 30130 pixels meet it. Selected needs 294.75862 at the median and 0 meet it.
THE CEILING MOVED THE WAY GELB SAID IT COULD ONLY MOVE: the brightest pixel reaches c/q 73.20 with a halo share of 0.8992, so its corrected requirement is 83.5 — a shortfall of 1.14x where the uncorrected comparison was 75.1 against 73.20, a shortfall of 1.03x. The 2.5 % that GELB ruled INCONCLUSIVE is not 2.5 % once the share is carried.
NO VERDICT (A-G36 point 2): this is a resolution and a population. PG-12 IS ESTABLISHED UNSATISFIABLE BY ANY BUILD (§36 — THIS LANE'S OWN finding, already recorded in gruen-pg12-chroma.mjs: the hue's own chroma is half the bound), so there is NO verdict to refer. These are measurability readings about a CHANNEL, not evidence toward an open pin. The earlier form of this sentence said "whether PG-12 is satisfied is PINK's" — referring a settled negative to another lane, which is the exact waste A-G111 exists to prevent, and the settlement was in my own record when I wrote it.
